title: Cyber-Secure Wearable, Ultra-Low-Power Networked Sensors for Soldier Health Monitoring: Insights from the CAPSARII project
abstract: arXiv:2611.20187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The CAPSARII project advances a cyber-secure, ultra-low-power wearable platform and Internet of Battlefield Things (IoBT) framework to support real-time monitoring of military personnel and data-driven decision support. The architecture integrates smart-textile sensing, a body/squad area mesh, edge-deployed AI on secure RISC-V microcontrollers, and cloud/federated analytics for cross-mission learning and comparative studies. Two representative use cases--pilot fatigue and warfighters operating in harsh environments--guide requirements, validation, and interface design (including HUD and haptic feedback).   As an initial step toward embedded models, we benchmark stress classification on a public wearable dataset: tree-ensemble baselines achieve state-of-the-art performance for accuracy and F1 (e.g., XGBoost: $\mathrm{Accuracy}=0.901\!\pm\!0.023$, $\mathrm{F1}=0.920\!\pm\!0.019$), while a feature-based Transformer attains the highest AUC

translated_title: 面向士兵健康监测的网络安全的可穿戴超低功耗网络化传感器：来自CAPSARII项目的见解
translated_abstract: CAPSARII项目推进了一个网络安全、超低功耗的可穿戴平台和战场物联网框架，以支持对军事人员的实时监测和数据驱动的决策支持。该架构集成了智能织物传感、身体/小队区域网格网络、部署在安全RISC-V微控制器上的边缘AI，以及用于跨任务学习和对比研究的云端/联邦分析。两个代表性用例——飞行员疲劳以及在恶劣环境中作战的士兵——指导了系统的需求、验证和界面设计（包括平视显示器和触觉反馈）。作为迈向嵌入式模型的初步步骤，我们在公开的可穿戴数据集上对压力分类进行了基准测试：树集成基线模型在准确率和F1分数方面达到了最先进的性能（例如，XGBoost：准确率=0.901±0.023，F1=0.920±0.019），而基于特征的Transformer则获得了最高的AUC。
tldr: CAPSARII项目提出了一个集成智能织物传感、安全RISC-V边缘AI和云端/联邦分析的网络安全超低功耗可穿戴平台与战场物联网架构，用于士兵健康实时监测，并在压力分类基准测试中取得了先进性能。
en_tdlr: The CAPSARII project presents a cyber-secure, ultra-low-power wearable platform and IoBT architecture integrating smart-textile sensing, edge AI on secure RISC-V microcontrollers, and cloud/federated analytics for soldier health monitoring, achieving state-of-the-art performance in stress classification benchmarks.
